display.purpose: Couple names on the hero — the largest, most emotionally weighted text.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, descriptions, form text. Optimized for mobile reading.

label.purpose: Category headers, countdown units, FAQ question labels. Always uppercase with wide tracking.

motion.name: reveal-in
motion.purpose: Scroll-reveal fade-in with 8px upward translate. One-shot, triggered by IntersectionObserver.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.value: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease
motion.purpose: Subtle color transitions on button hovers, toggle states, and input focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sole CTA button. Bronze fill, ivory text, minimal radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); color: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); padding: 12px 32px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(181, 126, 127, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy, #000040); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle Button
components.description: Binary choice button used in the RSVP form. Bronze fill when selected, outlined when not.
components.css: .ds-toggle { padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1.125rem; border: 1px solid rgba(19,19,19,0.2); background: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-ink, #131313); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-toggle[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); color: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); border-color: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy, #000040); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field with ivory background, subtle border, bronze focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.7); } .ds-input { background: var(--color-ivory, #FFFFFF); color: var(--color-ink, #131313); border: 1px solid rgba(19,19,19,0.2); border-radius: 4px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1.125rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-bronze, #B57E7F); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-navy, #000040); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Split Section
components.description: Asymmetric two-column layout: 65/35 or 35/65 image-text split. Stacks vertically on mobile.
components.css: .ds-split { display: flex; min-height: 100dvh; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 65fr 35fr; } } .ds-split-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 48px 32px; } .ds-split-image { position: relative; overflow: hidden; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-split-text { height: 50dvh; padding: 24px; } .ds-split-image { height: 50dvh; } }

components.name: Countdown
components.description: Four-cell numeric countdown. Serif numerals, uppercase sans labels.
components.css: .ds-countdown { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-countdown { gap: 24px; } } .ds-countdown-cell { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-countdown-num { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 2.5rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink, #131313); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-countdown-num { font-size: 3rem; } } .ds-countdown-label { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: rgba(19,19,19,0.55); }

narrative.overview: A restrained, warm visual world built on cream and bronze. The system prioritizes clarity and ceremony over decoration: full-viewport scroll-snap sections create a page-by-page reading rhythm, serif headings carry emotional weight while sans-serif body text stays effortlessly legible. Every element earns its place — no ornamental borders, no gradient washes, no hover theatrics beyond a subtle opacity shift.
keyCharacteristics: Cream background with bronze accent on a strict two-color-plus-neutrals palette
Full-viewport scroll-snap sections as the primary spatial model
Serif/sans pairing (Cormorant Garamond + Jost) for display/body hierarchy
Minimal elevation — flat surfaces, no shadows, depth through image cropping and split layouts

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Bronze is the only chromatic accent on any screen. It is used on CTAs, active states, and a handful of label treatments — never more than ~15% of visible area.

rules.name: The Navy-is-for-Focus Rule
rules.body: Navy appears only as a :focus-visible outline. It is not a text color, background, or decorative element.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Letter-Spacing Rule
rules.body: Labels and category headers use uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-[0.3em]. This creates visual distinction from body text without adding a third font.

rules.name: The Text-Balance Rule
rules.body: Headings use style={{ textWrap: "balance" }} to prevent orphaned words on narrow screens.

dos: Do use bronze sparingly — it is the only accent, and its scarcity gives it weight.
Do use textWrap: "balance" on all headings to prevent orphaned words.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion — the Reveal component and .reveal CSS class both handle this.
Do use tabular-nums on any numeric display (countdown, counters) for stable digit widths.
Do keep split sections at 65/35 — this ratio creates asymmetric visual interest without feeling unbalanced.
donts: Don't add box-shadows. The system is flat; depth comes from images and typography weight.
Don't use navy for anything other than focus-visible outlines.
Don't use more than one accent color on a screen. Bronze is it.
Don't add decorative borders, dividers, or ornamental elements. Let whitespace do the work.
Don't use rounded-lg or larger radius — the system's corner language is subtle (4px).
Don't animate with transforms beyond the established 8px translateY reveal pattern.
